featured_reviews.name: aditya kulkarni
featured_reviews.review_text:
It is named rareism for a reason. Visited Rareism and wow — everything truly lived up to the name.
Rare designs, rare assistance, and rare customer etiquette.
Basically, rarity everywhere, except the bill, which arrived instantly and was very much present.

The clothes looked trendy, but finding something worth buying felt like spotting a rare species in the wild. Staff behaviour? Let’s just say basic courtesy seems to be an endangered trait here. I spent more time waiting for someone to acknowledge my existence than I did browsing.

I guess the brand philosophy is:
Style – Rare.
Help – Rarer.
Smiles – Extinct.

If you’re into treasure hunts with no treasure, you’ll love this place.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Ordered a shirt online and after three days they contacted me and informed me that the shirt which I ordered is out of stock.
They were courteous enough to inform and process my refund.
Looks like some gap in stocks shown on website and actual stocks.
Certainly not the kind of experience one would look for.
Will I order again: mostly no

featured_reviews.name: Ramesh Meshram
featured_reviews.review_text: I have visited Vakola store for exchange of my order No.SC46973 (shirts) on 30th March,2019 (Saturday) at around 11.30 am, and surprisingly see that the shutter of the shop was shut down . In their website the time of the shop is open till 3 pm. but actually it was closed that day. My time, & travelling money both are wasted because of wrong information given in their website.

featured_reviews.name: Edit O' Delete
featured_reviews.review_text: While it is not really a store, they do sell from here as well but they don't have a trial room / stall. Also, they do not do alterations to a shirt if the sizing is not correct. What you see is what you get.

featured_reviews.name: abdulaziz shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: I have Brought Atleast 9/10 Shirts Twill White Half Sleeves High Quality Fabric Great Nice Finishing in Stitching And Above All Very Very Good Shirts I am Loving to Wear it Thanks Stiff Collar

featured_reviews.review_text: If you want French cuff, cent percent cotton shirts, this is the place.  It's you visit this place in person, you get 20% discount too.  Very good quality.
